setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1 on MIDI channel 1: C, D, E and F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65; velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) on steps 1 to 4 at 90 BPM, rate /1. Harmony is Off with its default registers and Failure fallback SILENCE. Playback is stopped and the norns shows the Device page. This scene shows what happens when a register leaves no room for a note, as it can after you shift a voice into an unusual range.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Open Channel tasks > Harmony. Its list holds Mode, Register, Tone Map, Result and the Entry / Failure row used later. Turn E3 to set Mode to PATTERN, select Register with E2 and press K3.
steps.title: Open the Bass register

steps.caption: On the Bass rows turn E2 to Low and E3 to set it to 50. The Low row reads 50.
steps.title: Raise Bass Low to 50

steps.caption: Turn E2 to High and E3 to set it to 50. The High row reads 50, so the register is now the single note 50.
steps.title: Lower Bass High to 50

steps.caption: Turn E2 to Centre and E3 to set it to 50. MIDI 50 is a D, so this register holds no C at all. The Centre row reads 50.
steps.title: Centre the Bass register on 50

steps.caption: Press K3, then E1 back to the Harmony list, select Tone Map with E2 and press K3. Turn E3 so Tone 0, the written C, goes to Bass, and press K3.
steps.title: Send the written C to Bass

steps.caption: Tap Play for two loops, then Stop. Step 1 is silent while D, E and F sound (MIDI 62, 64, 65 in the strip below), because Bass has no C to play.
steps.title: Hear the silent step

steps.caption: Press E1 to go back to the Harmony list, select Result with E2 and press K3.
steps.title: Open Result

steps.caption: Read Result for step 1. Status reads NO VOICING RANGE and CH1 reads NO EVENT, because nothing was sent; a Failure details row appears and K3 opens it.
steps.title: Read the failure

steps.caption: Optional check first: turn E3 to step 5; Status and CH1 read NO EVENT there because the loop has no trig on step 5, which differs from step 1, where an event existed but could not be voiced. Turn Step back to 1, press K2 to return to the list, select Entry and press K3. The Entry / Failure page lists Failure fallback.
steps.title: Find Entry / Failure

steps.caption: Select Failure fallback and turn E3 once right: it reads LEGACY. Press K3 to apply.
steps.title: Choose Legacy

steps.caption: Tap Play for two loops, then Stop. C D E F return (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65): step 1 now plays through its original C instead of falling silent.
steps.title: Hear the fallback

steps.caption: Reopen Result: step 1 now reads Status LEGACY RANGE and CH1 C3 > C3 (planned > sent), the sign that the written pitch was used on purpose.
steps.title: Confirm Legacy in Result

title: See a failed voicing and choose a fallback
